title: TF Classification - Dealing with Overfitting and Evaluation

cues.en: (warm music)
cues.zh: （溫暖音樂）

cues.en: Instructor: Welcome back everyone to part two of our classification code along.
cues.zh: 講師：各位，歡迎回到分類實作的第二部分。

cues.en: In part two we're going to create the model and then show you how to help prevent overfitting of the model.
cues.zh: 這部分會建立模型，並示範如何協助防止模型過度擬合。

cues.en: Let's head back to the notebook and continue where we left off last time.
cues.zh: 回到筆記本，接續上次的進度。

cues.en: Okay, I'm going to begin by importing tensorflow, actually, we'll say from tensorflow.
cues.zh: 好，先匯入 TensorFlow；其實我們寫 from tensorflow。

cues.en: From tensorflow.keras.models import sequential, make sure you spell import right, run that.
cues.zh: 使用 from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential，確認 import 拼對，然後執行。

cues.en: And then we'll also say from tensorflow.keras.layers import.
cues.zh: 再使用 from tensorflow.keras.layers import。

cues.en: And we'll first start off using dense layers but we'll also add in dropout layers later on.
cues.zh: 一開始先用 Dense 層，稍後也會加入 Dropout 層。

cues.en: Okay, so let's create a very simple model given what we know so far about creating models.
cues.zh: 根據目前學過的模型建立方式，建立一個非常簡單的模型。

cues.en: So right now in my training set, I have 426 rows, so not a whole lot of rows and then 30 features.
cues.zh: 訓練集現在有 426 列，列數不算多，另外有 30 個特徵。

cues.en: So what I will do is I will create a sequential model
cues.zh: 所以我會建立 Sequential 模型，

cues.en: and then I will add in a first layer of 30 neurons
cues.zh: 第一層加入 30 個神經元，

cues.en: and you can say units equal to 30 if you want.
cues.zh: 想明確寫出 units=30 也可以。

cues.en: And then the activation will just be a rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: 激活函數就使用整流線性單元。

cues.en: And then we will repeat that except we'll go ahead and cut that in half.
cues.zh: 再做一次，不過把數量減半。

cues.en: So the next layer will go down to 15 and we'll keep things simple so that we have one last output layer and this is just going to be one neuron.
cues.zh: 下一層降成 15，接著為了簡單，最後輸出層只用一個神經元。

cues.en: However, the activation and this is critical, will be sigmoid because this is a binary classification problem.
cues.zh: 但激活函數必須是 sigmoid，這點很重要，因為這是二元分類問題。

cues.en: So for a binary classification problem, we want the last activation to be sigmoid.
cues.zh: 二元分類的最後激活函數要用 sigmoid。

cues.en: Check out the theory lectures on this if you are a little fuzzy on why we're choosing that specific activation.
cues.zh: 如果不太確定為什麼選它，請查看相關理論課程。

cues.en: So we have binary classification, one neuron, outputting something between a zero and one and that will decide what class this belongs to, either malignant or benign.
cues.zh: 所以二元分類使用一個神經元，輸出零到一之間的值，判斷屬於惡性或良性哪一類。

cues.en: And then we'll compile this.
cues.zh: 接著編譯。

cues.en: So we'll say model compile and we also have to make sure this loss call is correct.
cues.zh: 呼叫 model.compile，也要確認 loss 設定正確。

cues.en: This should be binary_crossentropy in order for it to work correctly.
cues.zh: 必須使用 binary_crossentropy，才能正確運作。

cues.en: And then the optimizer, we have lots of different options here, but we'll go ahead and just choose an adam optimizer.
cues.zh: optimizer 有許多選擇，但這裡就選 Adam。

cues.en: So we created our model and now it's time to train the model.
cues.zh: 模型建立好了，現在開始訓練。

cues.en: We'll say model.fit and we'll say X is equal to X train, Y is equal to Y train,
cues.zh: 呼叫 model.fit，X=X_train、y=y_train，

cues.en: and then epochs.
cues.zh: 然後設定 epochs。

cues.en: And I'm gonna choose a really large number of epochs here.
cues.zh: 我會選一個非常大的 epoch 數。

cues.en: So 600, there's probably way too many for this particular training but I wanna specifically actually show you what it looks like when you overfit to your training data.
cues.zh: 設成 600，對這個訓練大概太多，但我就是想示範過度擬合訓練資料的樣子。

cues.en: And to do that, we're also gonna pass in our validation data.
cues.zh: 為此，也要傳入驗證資料。

cues.en: So we'll say validation data and we'll pass in X test and Y test.
cues.zh: 設定 validation_data，傳入 X_test 和 y_test。

cues.en: So go ahead and run this and this will take a while because we're running it for so many epochs.
cues.zh: 執行後會花一段時間，因為 epoch 很多。

cues.en: So I'm going to fast forward in time until this is done training on the 600 epochs.
cues.zh: 我會快轉，直到這 600 個 epoch 訓練完成。

cues.en: So that's 600 times through the entire training set.
cues.zh: 就是把整個訓練集跑 600 次。

cues.en: So lemme fast forward in time.
cues.zh: 我先快轉。

cues.en: Okay, this has just finished training for those 600 epochs.
cues.zh: 好，剛剛完成 600 個 epoch。

cues.en: What we're going to do now is we'll go ahead and plot out the loss and remember we passed in our validation data during the training.
cues.zh: 現在把損失畫出來；還記得，訓練時有傳入驗證資料。

cues.en: So we'll be able to plot out both the training loss and the validation loss.
cues.zh: 所以可以同時畫出訓練損失與驗證損失。

cues.en: Recall that I can say model.history.history and I can pass that into a pandas dataframe
cues.zh: 使用 model.history.history，再傳入 pandas DataFrame，

cues.en: and we'll call that losses.
cues.zh: 我們把它叫 losses。

cues.en: And then here's my losses, I have the training loss and the validation loss.
cues.zh: 這裡有訓練損失和驗證損失。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and plot this out and see what this looks like.
cues.zh: 畫出來看看。

cues.en: So here are my losses and this is a perfect example of overfitting.
cues.zh: 這些損失曲線就是過度擬合的典型例子。

cues.en: So what is the key characteristic here of overfitting?
cues.zh: 過度擬合的關鍵特徵是什麼？

cues.en: You'll notice in the beginning, during the first couple of epochs, both validation and training loss are both decreasing.
cues.zh: 一開始的幾個 epoch，驗證損失和訓練損失都下降。

cues.en: That's good.
cues.zh: 這很好。

cues.en: That means we haven't yet overfit to our training data and as we go along, we're decreasing loss in both the validation set and the training set.
cues.zh: 表示還沒有過度擬合，持續訓練時，驗證集和訓練集的損失都在降低。

cues.en: However, at a certain point in time, notice that our training loss here in blue, is still going down.
cues.zh: 不過到某個時間點，注意藍色訓練損失仍在下降，

cues.en: However, our validation loss is beginning to increase.
cues.zh: 但驗證損失開始上升。

cues.en: That basically tells us that we're overfitting to our training dataset.
cues.zh: 基本上就表示對訓練集過度擬合。

cues.en: So we have a clear indication here that we're training just for too many epochs, notice the validation loss gets worse and worse after these epochs.
cues.zh: 很清楚可以看出 epoch 太多，因為這些 epoch 之後，驗證損失越來越差。

cues.en: So what we're going to do is we're going to see if we can use early stopping.
cues.zh: 所以接下來看看能否使用提前停止。

cues.en: So we've obviously trained too much and what we're going to do is show you how to use tensorflow keras callbacks to actually, based on your validation loss, stop the training
cues.zh: 我們顯然訓練太多了；接下來示範 TensorFlow Keras 的 callbacks，根據驗證損失停止訓練，

cues.en: before it gets out of hand as shown here.
cues.zh: 避免發展成這裡失控的情況。

cues.en: So I'm going to copy and paste our model again.
cues.zh: 再複製貼上模型。

cues.en: And this is kind of important in order to show this because we don't want to keep training on the same model.
cues.zh: 為了示範，這點很重要，因為不想繼續訓練同一個模型。

cues.en: I want to recreate the model fresh.
cues.zh: 我要重新建立全新的模型。

cues.en: So I will copy and paste these commands.
cues.zh: 所以複製貼上這些指令。

cues.en: So scroll down, go ahead and basically redefine your model again.
cues.zh: 往下捲，基本上重新定義模型。

cues.en: And then let me show you how we can use callbacks.
cues.zh: 接著示範如何使用 callbacks。

cues.en: And these are not the only callbacks we'll be using throughout the course.
cues.zh: 這不是整門課唯一會用到的回呼。

cues.en: This is our first instance of using one, we'll say from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import.
cues.zh: 這是第一個例子，使用 from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import。

cues.en: And the callback we'll be learning about right now is called early stopping.
cues.zh: 現在要學的回呼叫 EarlyStopping。

cues.en: And I would encourage you to call help on early stopping to see the full details on it.
cues.zh: 我建議對 EarlyStopping 呼叫 help，查看完整細節。

cues.en: But basically what's happening here is we have to choose a metric to monitor and in our case it will be validation loss, this orange metric right here.
cues.zh: 基本上，我們要選擇監控的指標，這裡是驗證損失，也就是橘色這條。

cues.en: So we're gonna be tracking that validation loss.
cues.zh: 我們會追蹤驗證損失。

cues.en: And then you can also specify things like the minimum change required.
cues.zh: 也可以指定要求的最小變化量等設定。

cues.en: Also there's patience, which is the number of epochs with no improvement, after which training will be stopped.
cues.zh: 還有 patience，表示經過多少個沒有改善的 epoch 後，停止訓練。

cues.en: So it doesn't just do a hard stop the minute that validation loss goes up a little bit.
cues.zh: 所以不是驗證損失一稍微上升，就立刻硬性停止。

cues.en: You can see that throughout training there is a little bit of noise.
cues.zh: 訓練過程中會有一些雜訊。

cues.en: So maybe we wanna wait a couple of epochs so we can have that patience parameter there as well.
cues.zh: 所以可能想多等幾個 epoch，就能用 patience 參數。

cues.en: And we also have different modes of training.
cues.zh: 也有不同模式。

cues.en: So lots of different things you can explore here and you can even see the full example that's available to you in the dock stream.
cues.zh: 有很多設定可以探索，文件字串也有完整範例。

cues.en: But lemme show you how to use this early stopping.
cues.zh: 不過先示範這個提前停止的用法。

cues.en: And the early stopping has basically two steps.
cues.zh: 基本上有兩個步驟。

cues.en: One is to define the variable.
cues.zh: 第一是定義變數。

cues.en: Early stop is equal to early stopping.
cues.zh: 讓 early_stop 等於 EarlyStopping。

cues.en: So we do that actual call and in our case, we're going to be monitoring validation loss.
cues.zh: 呼叫它，這裡監控驗證損失。

cues.en: And then the mode that we're actually looking for is min.
cues.zh: 我們要用的 mode 是 min。

cues.en: So there's a couple of different modes here.
cues.zh: 這裡有幾種模式。

cues.en: We can go back up here and check them out.
cues.zh: 回上面查看。

cues.en: Recall that the mode is basically, what are you actually trying to do here?
cues.zh: mode 基本上就是問，你實際想做什麼？

cues.en: Are you trying to minimize the thing you're monitoring?
cues.zh: 你想讓監控的量最小化？

cues.en: Are you trying to maximize the thing you're monitoring, et cetera, so you can imagine if our metric was accuracy, accuracy is something you want to maximize.
cues.zh: 還是最大化？例如指標是 accuracy，就會想讓準確率最大化。

cues.en: If our metric is loss, essentially the reverse of accuracy, loss is something you want to minimize.
cues.zh: 若指標是 loss，基本上和準確率方向相反，就要最小化。

cues.en: So keep that in mind.
cues.zh: 請記住。

cues.en: And there's also this nice little auto string that basically the direction is automatically inferred from the name of the monitored quantity.
cues.zh: 還有方便的 auto 字串，會根據監控量的名稱，自動推斷方向。

cues.en: So it'll infer it based off the string.
cues.zh: 它會依據字串推斷。

cues.en: That usually almost always works but just in case it doesn't, I would recommend that you manually put in min or max.
cues.zh: 通常幾乎都能成功，但以防萬一，我建議手動指定 min 或 max。

cues.en: It also lets you know that you know enough about the metric you're actually tracking to understand what you should be doing for early stopping.
cues.zh: 也能確認自己充分理解所追蹤的指標，知道提前停止應採什麼方向。

cues.en: So in this case, we're tracking our validation loss which is what we want to minimize because if we have a loss of zero, that means we have a perfect fit.
cues.zh: 這裡追蹤驗證損失，要讓它最小化，因為損失為零代表完美擬合。

cues.en: So we'll go ahead and say early stopping, monitor our validation loss, try to minimize it.
cues.zh: 所以設定 EarlyStopping，監控驗證損失，目標是最小化。

cues.en: And we'll also say verbose is equal to one, basically just have a little report back and then we'll set patience equal to 25.
cues.zh: 也設定 verbose=1，顯示簡短訊息，再設定 patience=25。

cues.en: That means we'll wait 25 epochs even after we've kind of detected a stopping point because of noise that could occur.
cues.zh: 這表示即使偵測到可能的停止點，也會因為雜訊而多等 25 個 epoch。

cues.en: So we create this early stop variable and then upon calling model.fit and I'm going to copy the same command we used before.
cues.zh: 建立 early_stop 變數，再呼叫 model.fit；我會複製之前相同的指令。

cues.en: So up here we have our original model fit command, just go ahead and copy that.
cues.zh: 上面就是原本的 model.fit，直接複製。

cues.en: So we'll go ahead and copy the contents of that cell, make sure you've redefined the model again otherwise you'll accidentally be training the old model.
cues.zh: 複製那個儲存格的內容，確認先重新定義模型，否則會意外繼續訓練舊模型。

cues.en: So we just redefine the model again and now I'm calling model.fit.
cues.zh: 重新定義模型後，現在呼叫 model.fit。

cues.en: Everything looks the same, except now I'm going to add in a couple more lines here.
cues.zh: 所有設定都一樣，只是多加幾行。

cues.en: We'll say callback parameter or callbacks is equal to and you actually actually pass this in as a list, even if it's just one
cues.zh: 設定 callbacks 參數，必須用清單傳入，即使只有一個，

cues.en: and you pass in that early stop callback.
cues.zh: 也要把 early_stop 回呼放進清單。

cues.en: So go ahead and run this and now what's going to happen is it's going to attempt to run on 600 epochs unless the early stop is triggered.
cues.zh: 執行後，它會嘗試訓練 600 個 epoch，除非提前停止被觸發。

cues.en: And in this case, note that the early stop was triggered and if you scroll down here, it stopped training after 81.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡已觸發提前停止；往下看，在 81 個 epoch 後就停止了。

cues.en: So it has that early stopping call.
cues.zh: 有顯示提前停止訊息。

cues.en: So that's nice, now we know that 600 was too much.
cues.zh: 很好，現在知道 600 太多了。

cues.en: And what's also nice about this is you can now with early stopping, choose some arbitrarily large number of epochs and then indicate that you want it to stop early with this callback.
cues.zh: 另一個好處是，現在可以隨意設一個很大的 epoch 數，再透過回呼要求提前停止。

cues.en: So now you don't have to worry too much about choosing the correct number for epochs since callbacks with early stop will take care of that for you automatically.
cues.zh: 因此不必太擔心選擇正確的 epoch 數，EarlyStopping 回呼會自動處理。

cues.en: Let's now check out that model loss.
cues.zh: 現在查看模型損失。

cues.en: So we'll say model loss is equal to this pandas dataframe call on model.history.history
cues.zh: 讓 model_loss 等於對 model.history.history 呼叫 pandas DataFrame 的結果，

cues.en: and then we will say model loss plot.
cues.zh: 再呼叫 model_loss.plot。

cues.en: Go ahead and run this.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And this is exactly the kind of plot that we want to see where loss and validation loss are both beginning to go down and right as they begin to spread out,
cues.zh: 這就是想看到的圖：損失和驗證損失都開始下降，當它們開始分離時，

cues.en: that's probably a good indication of where we should stop training.
cues.zh: 大概就是應該停止訓練的良好指標。

cues.en: So notice this flattening out, that's okay behavior.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡逐漸變平是可以接受的。

cues.en: What we wanna prevent is validation loss beginning to increase and that's what was happening, so early stop was triggered.
cues.zh: 我們想避免驗證損失開始增加，而剛才正發生這件事，所以觸發了提前停止。

cues.en: Alright, so the third thing we can do to try to help prevent overfitting is add in dropout layers.
cues.zh: 好，第三種有助於防止過度擬合的方法，是加入 Dropout 層。

cues.en: So dropout layers will essentially turn off a percentage of neurons randomly.
cues.zh: Dropout 層基本上會隨機關閉一定比例的神經元。

cues.en: So let's come back up here and I'm going to copy and paste my model again to make sure I don't accidentally keep training my old model.
cues.zh: 回到上面，再複製貼上模型，避免意外繼續訓練舊模型。

cues.en: So there's my model again and what I'm going to do is I'm also, you can do this in the same cell or in the cell above it,
cues.zh: 模型又放好了；接下來可以在同一個儲存格或上方儲存格，

cues.en: we'll say from tensorflow.keras.layers import dropout.
cues.zh: 使用 from tensorflow.keras.layers import Dropout。

cues.en: We've technically already done this.
cues.zh: 其實我們已經匯入過。

cues.en: I just want to clarify that the dropout call comes from keras.layers and you should have already imported this before, but go ahead and just do it again.
cues.zh: 我只是想說明 Dropout 來自 keras.layers；先前應該已匯入，但再做一次也可以。

cues.en: And what we're going to do is after each of these two dense layers, we will add in the dropout call, we'll say model.add, and then we say dropout.
cues.zh: 在這兩個 Dense 層之後，分別加入 Dropout，使用 model.add(Dropout(...))。

cues.en: And then the main parameter you choose with dropout, you can do shift tab here.
cues.zh: Dropout 的主要參數，可以按 Shift+Tab 查看。

cues.en: And you'll notice that the main thing is basically rate and the rate is the probability that you're going to randomly turn off the actual neurons.
cues.zh: 主要是 rate，也就是隨機關閉神經元的機率。

cues.en: So it's the fraction of which you are randomly turning them off.
cues.zh: 它表示隨機關閉的比例。

cues.en: So if you put a zero, that means you are taking 0% of the neurons and randomly turning them off during training.
cues.zh: 如果設成零，代表訓練時隨機關閉 0% 的神經元。

cues.en: If you put a one here, you typically would never do that, but that basically means that 100% of the neurons are going to be turned off randomly for each batch of training.
cues.zh: 如果設成一，通常絕對不會這樣做，但基本上表示每個訓練批次都隨機關閉 100% 的神經元。

cues.en: So what is a really common value is somewhere between 0.2 and 0.5.
cues.zh: 常見數值介於 0.2 和 0.5。

cues.en: And essentially that means is half the neurons during each batch, essentially each batch is one entire epoch of training.
cues.zh: 基本上表示每個批次關閉一半的神經元；每個批次基本上就是一整個訓練 epoch。

cues.en: In our case, because we haven't specified a batch size, half of those neurons in this layer of 30 are going to be turned off so their weights and biases won't be getting updated.
cues.zh: 這裡因為沒有指定 batch_size，所以這層 30 個神經元的一半會關閉，權重和偏置不會更新。

cues.en: So we'll go ahead and put that here as well.
cues.zh: 這裡也加入相同設定。

cues.en: And that means, again, about half of these neurons are going to be turned off randomly so it's not the same neurons each time.
cues.zh: 再說一次，大約一半神經元會隨機關閉，所以每次不會都是相同的神經元。

cues.en: It's a random sub selection of 50% of the neurons.
cues.zh: 是隨機選取 50% 的神經元。

cues.en: Okay, so that each neuron has essentially a 50% probability of being turned off during each batch.
cues.zh: 也就是每個神經元在每個批次，基本上都有 50% 機率被關閉。

cues.en: So go ahead and rerun this, so we redefine our model and then we'll use this in combination with dropout.
cues.zh: 重新執行，重新定義模型，再配合 Dropout 使用。

cues.en: So we can still retain the same early stopping here but I'm going to copy and paste the contents of this model.fit.
cues.zh: 還能保留相同的提前停止設定，我會複製貼上這個 model.fit 的內容。

cues.en: We still have our early stopping and now we've added in these dropouts.
cues.zh: 我們仍有提前停止，現在又加入 Dropout。
